mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.app_user where id = #{userId} and state = 'ACTIVE')

select p.id as projectId, p.tenant_id as tenantId, p.state as projectState, t.state as tenantState from pep_platform.project p join pep_platform.tenant t on t.id = p.tenant_id where p.id = #{projectId}
select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and user_id = #{userId} and state = 'ACTIVE')
select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.tenant_member where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and user_id = #{userId} and state = 'ACTIVE')

select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role_permission p on p.role_id = b.role_id where b.principal_type in ('USER', 'GROUP') and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text and p.permission_code = #{permission} and ( (b.scope_type = 'PLATFORM' and b.scope_id = '*') or (b.scope_type = 'TENANT' and b.scope_id = #{tenantId}::text) or (b.scope_type = 'PROJECT' and b.scope_id = #{projectId}::text)))

select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role_permission p on p.role_id = b.role_id where b.principal_type in ('USER', 'GROUP') and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text and p.permission_code = #{permission} and b.scope_type = 'PLATFORM' and b.scope_id = '*')
